# Raymarching: Shaders

Complete, runnable shaders for each demo in the notes.

---

## sdf-circle-2d

```glsl
float sdCircle(vec2 p, float r) {
    return length(p) - r;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float d = sdCircle(p, 1.0);

    // Color by sign: blue inside, orange outside
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    // Darken near the boundary
    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Highlight the zero level set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## sdf-box-2d

```glsl
float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 halfSize) {
    vec2 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float d = sdBox(p, vec2(0.8, 0.5));

    // Color by sign: blue inside, orange outside
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    // Darken near the boundary
    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Highlight the zero level set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## sphere

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return sdSphere(p, 1.0);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        vec3 surfaceColor = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        vec3 ambient = surfaceColor * 0.15;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, surfaceColor);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## torus

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return sdTorus(p, 1.0, 0.4);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        vec3 surfaceColor = vec3(0.0, 0.7, 1.0);
        vec3 ambient = surfaceColor * 0.15;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, surfaceColor);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## scene-multi

Multiple objects, single color (before getMaterial).

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float sphere = sdSphere(p - vec3(-1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 1.0);
    float torus = sdTorus(p - vec3(1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 0.8, 0.3);
    float ground = sdPlane(p, -1.0);
    return min(sphere, min(torus, ground));
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        vec3 surfaceColor = vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.2);
        vec3 ambient = surfaceColor * 0.15;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, surfaceColor);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## scene-complete

Full scene with getMaterial for per-object colors.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Sphere {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Torus {
    vec3 center;
    float majorRadius;
    float minorRadius;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// Primitive SDFs
float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// Object SDFs
float sdf(vec3 p, Sphere s) {
    return sdSphere(p - s.center, s.radius);
}

float sdf(vec3 p, Torus t) {
    return sdTorus(p - t.center, t.majorRadius, t.minorRadius);
}

// Scene objects
Sphere ball = Sphere(vec3(-1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 1.0, vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
Torus ring = Torus(vec3(1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 0.8, 0.3, vec3(0.0, 0.7, 1.0));

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdf(p, ball);
    d = min(d, sdf(p, ring));
    d = min(d, sdPlane(p, -1.0));
    return d;
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdf(p, ball) < eps) return ball.color;
    if (sdf(p, ring) < eps) return ring.color;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.35);

    return vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.2);  // maroon = error
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15;
        color = ambient + shade(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## shadows

Scene with shadow rays traced toward the light.

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Sphere {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Torus {
    vec3 center;
    float majorRadius;
    float minorRadius;
    vec3 color;
};

const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// Primitive SDFs
float sdSphere(vec3 p, float radius) {
    return length(p) - radius;
}

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float majorRadius, float minorRadius) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - majorRadius, p.y);
    return length(q) - minorRadius;
}

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

// Object SDFs
float sdf(vec3 p, Sphere s) {
    return sdSphere(p - s.center, s.radius);
}

float sdf(vec3 p, Torus t) {
    return sdTorus(p - t.center, t.majorRadius, t.minorRadius);
}

// Scene objects
Sphere ball = Sphere(vec3(-1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 1.0, vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
Torus ring = Torus(vec3(1.5, 0.0, 0.0), 0.8, 0.3, vec3(0.0, 0.7, 1.0));

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdf(p, ball);
    d = min(d, sdf(p, ring));
    d = min(d, sdPlane(p, -1.0));
    return d;
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdf(p, ball) < eps) return ball.color;
    if (sdf(p, ring) < eps) return ring.color;
    if (sdPlane(p, -1.0) < eps) return vec3(0.3, 0.3, 0.35);

    return vec3(0.5, 0.0, 0.2);  // maroon = error
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

float shadow(vec3 p) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float t = 0.02;

    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        float d = sdScene(p + lightDir * t);

        if (d < 0.001) return 0.0;

        t += d;

        if (t > 20.0) break;
    }

    return 1.0;
}

vec3 shade(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceColor) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return surfaceColor * diffuse;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);

        float sh = shadow(p + normal * 0.01);

        vec3 ambient = material * 0.15;
        vec3 lit = shade(normal, material);
        color = ambient + lit * sh;
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```
